title: A16EEN — Notes for a Brighter Day
description: An offline collection of uplifting classics and original A16EEN reminders. Quotes rotate randomly every six hours while the widget is enabled.

quotes.text: I dwell in Possibility — a fairer house than prose.
quotes.author: Emily Dickinson

quotes.text: Hope is the thing with feathers that perches in the soul.
quotes.author: Emily Dickinson
quotes.source: Poem beginning “Hope is the thing with feathers”

quotes.text: Forever is composed of nows.
quotes.author: Emily Dickinson
quotes.source: Poem beginning “Forever is composed of nows”

quotes.text: The sun himself is weak when he first rises, and gathers strength and courage as the day gets on.
quotes.author: Charles Dickens

quotes.text: Keep your face to the sunshine and you cannot see a shadow.
quotes.author: Helen Keller

quotes.text: Life is either a daring adventure or nothing.
quotes.author: Helen Keller

quotes.text: Nothing can dim the light that shines from within.
quotes.author: Maya Angelou

quotes.text: Try to be a rainbow in someone’s cloud.
quotes.author: Maya Angelou

quotes.text: Nothing will work unless you do.
quotes.author: Maya Angelou
quotes.source: Wouldn’t Take Nothing for My Journey Now

quotes.text: You must do the thing you think you cannot do.
quotes.author: Eleanor Roosevelt

quotes.text: The best way out is always through.
quotes.author: Robert Frost

quotes.text: Go confidently in the direction of your dreams. Live the life you have imagined.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.text: Not all those who wander are lost.
quotes.author: J. R. R. Tolkien

quotes.text: All we have to decide is what to do with the time that is given us.
quotes.author: J. R. R. Tolkien

quotes.text: There is no charm equal to tenderness of heart.
quotes.author: Jane Austen

quotes.text: I declare after all there is no enjoyment like reading!
quotes.author: Jane Austen

quotes.text: Be not afraid of greatness.
quotes.author: William Shakespeare
quotes.source: Twelfth Night, Act II, Scene V

quotes.text: Sweet are the uses of adversity.
quotes.author: William Shakespeare
quotes.source: As You Like It, Act II, Scene I

quotes.text: We know what we are, but know not what we may be.
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.text: To thine own self be true.
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.text: No legacy is so rich as honesty.
quotes.author: William Shakespeare
quotes.source: All’s Well That Ends Well, Act III, Scene V

quotes.text: Great things are done by a series of small things brought together.
quotes.author: Vincent van Gogh

quotes.text: What would life be if we had no courage to attempt anything?
quotes.author: Vincent van Gogh

quotes.text: The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.text: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.text: Faith is the bird that feels the light when the dawn is still dark.
quotes.author: Rabindranath Tagore

quotes.text: Let us be grateful to people who make us happy; they are the charming gardeners who make our souls blossom.
quotes.author: Marcel Proust

quotes.text: Happiness is not something ready made. It comes from your own actions.
quotes.author: Dalai Lama

quotes.text: The purpose of our lives is to be happy.
quotes.author: Dalai Lama

quotes.text: Success is the sum of small efforts, repeated day in and day out.
quotes.author: Robert Collier

quotes.text: One child, one teacher, one book, one pen can change the world.
quotes.author: Malala Yousafzai

quotes.text: No act of kindness, no matter how small, is ever wasted.
quotes.author: Aesop
quotes.source: The Lion and the Mouse (traditional attribution)

quotes.text: Well done is better than well said.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.text: Lost time is never found again.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.text: We are all in the gutter, but some of us are looking at the stars.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.text: I am rooted, but I flow.
quotes.author: Virginia Woolf

quotes.text: In every walk with nature one receives far more than he seeks.
quotes.author: John Muir

quotes.text: Faith is taking the first step even when you don’t see the whole staircase.
quotes.author: Martin Luther King Jr.

quotes.text: The time is always right to do what is right.
quotes.author: Martin Luther King Jr.

quotes.text: As long as you live, keep learning how to live.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: You can begin again without starting from nothing.
quotes.author: A16EEN

quotes.text: You don’t have to shine loudly to make the world brighter.
quotes.author: A16EEN

quotes.text: Make room for wonder. It has a way of finding you.
quotes.author: A16EEN

quotes.text: Keep the promises you make to yourself, especially the small ones.
quotes.author: A16EEN

quotes.text: Your attention is a garden; give beautiful things room to grow.
quotes.author: A16EEN

quotes.text: The good you practice becomes the good the world remembers.
quotes.author: A16EEN

quotes.text: A gentle beginning can still grow into something extraordinary.
quotes.author: A16EEN

quotes.text: May you be proud of your effort and gentle with your timing.
quotes.author: A16EEN

quotes.text: Let curiosity lead, courage steady you, and kindness guide you.
quotes.author: A16EEN

quotes.text: Notice what is good. Nurture what is growing. Keep going.
quotes.author: A16EEN

quotes.text: Make something beautiful from the hours you are given.
quotes.author: A16EEN

quotes.text: A small act of courage can open an entirely new world.
quotes.author: A16EEN

quotes.text: Let today hold a little more wonder, kindness, and possibility.
quotes.author: A16EEN

quotes.text: You do not need the whole road lit; the next step is enough.
quotes.author: A16EEN

quotes.text: The life you want is built in ordinary moments, lovingly repeated.
quotes.author: A16EEN

quotes.text: Carry kindness like light: it costs little and changes everything.
quotes.author: A16EEN

quotes.text: Your next chapter does not need permission from your last.
quotes.author: A16EEN

quotes.text: Some of the strongest growth happens where nobody is watching.
quotes.author: A16EEN
